pairs.subject: automated-screening-fairness-gates
pairs.evidence: app/features/library/jobs/jobsRecruiterCandidatesLogic.ts:167 This surface only ranks, filters and exports a fairness matrix, and its only candidate actions are add-to-pipeline and reach-out. It explicitly leaves the never-auto-reject guarantee to the engine. A search of app/features/library/jobs found no autoReject, isFairnessProtected, actOnPipelineEntry or screenWave, so the subject's precondition (an automated adverse action) does not hold here.

techniques.evidence: app/features/library/jobs/jobsRecruiterCandidatesLogic.ts:158 The score threshold here picks out promising candidates for display (surfacing). Nothing acts on it adversely, and the technique excludes ranking surfaces.

app/features/library/jobs/jobsRecruiterCandidatesLogic.ts:143 The only executable actions are adding a candidate to the pipeline and reaching out. Both are reversible and non-adverse, and there is no route field to narrow.

app/features/library/jobs/jobsFairnessMatrix.ts:22 The fairness matrix is an aggregate display artifact with no per-candidate branch that could withhold an adverse action. When its arrays do not line up it degrades to not assessed, which fits the technique's rule for aggregates.
